notes.title: A Big Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25349719/21faaad0ec73884d2da2cb7fc01b9037edd895ef.png[/img]

A long promised update now is live! I've been working on other projects but I wanted to make one more update for Freebie. It is live now!

Added:
-Leaderboard
-Partial Controller Support
-Pick Ups
-Screen Shake
-Main Menu now looks cute
-Achievements looks cuter
-Color Blind mode (To acess it, you must active a free DLC from Store page)

Now it's up to you to try and achieve the 1st spot on leaderboard!

Game got 10 times better than before! Thank you all for your kind support and good review! I wish all of you happy life, and for my audience in United States - go vote and make your country great again!

NOTE: I doubt I'll work more on this game. I move to work on other projects, that will be released by different name (you'll know about it when time comes). This game was released under developer name Free Games Info, it's my community of people that participate in giveaways and help each other get games for free. You can find the group on Steam if you wish! That group made me get in touch with many good developers, and I learned lot from them, and started few projects with them. If it wasn't for it, I would never make games. Thank once again. Have a nice day!

notes.title: A small update!
notes.content: Hey, I wasn't aware that I need to code in game about ability to take screenshot on Steam. So I just did it. You can now take screenshots using F12 or whatever you made your default screenshot button. I would like to see your score, so take some screenshots for me :)
